# Retro Chat

> A Claude Code mod that skins your chat as iMessage, MSN Messenger, AIM or IRC.

Retro Chat changes how the chat looks on your screen. It does not change what Claude sees or says. Switch with `/skin imessage`, `/skin msn`, `/skin aim` or `/skin irc`, and turn it off with `/skin off`. Each skin has its own message style, spinner text, pixel buddy and sounds. Settings are a screen name and a sounds switch. It is MIT licensed.

Install in Claude Code:

```
/plugin install retro-chat --marketplace hg913488/claude-code-retro-skins
```

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-retro-skins/blob/main/README.md): what the skins look like, install, settings, FAQ
- [Make your own skin](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-retro-skins/blob/main/docs/make-a-skin.md): add a skin to the mod
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-retro-skins/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, checks and conventions for coding agents

## Source

- [hooks/register.tsx](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-retro-skins/blob/main/hooks/register.tsx): the `/skin` command, sounds, popups and render hooks
- [skins/shared.ts](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-retro-skins/blob/main/skins/shared.ts): the `Skin` type and shared helpers
- [skins/msn.tsx](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-retro-skins/blob/main/skins/msn.tsx): a complete example skin
- [.claude-plugin/plugin.json](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-retro-skins/blob/main/.claude-plugin/plugin.json): plugin manifest and settings
- [tests/skins.test.tsx](https://github.com/hg913488/claude-code-retro-skins/blob/main/tests/skins.test.tsx): the test suite
